concerns.text: The plan enforces a hard‑stop when the post‑filter BCC count is < 80 (FR‑004) but provides no power analysis or justification that N ≥ 80 is sufficient to detect a meaningful relationship between compositional descriptors and yield strength. Without an explicit effect‑size / power calculation, the sample‑size criterion may be under‑powered, risking false‑negative conclusions.

The plan does not address potential confounding variables such as testing temperature, strain‑rate, or processing history, which are known to influence yield strength. Assuming all yield‑strength values are directly comparable (SC‑001) without controlling or adjusting for these factors threatens construct validity of the target variable and may bias model performance estimates.

While ILR transformation mitigates compositional closure, the plan lacks a justification for the selected scalar descriptors (δ, VEC, mixing entropy, mixing enthalpy, electronegativity difference) as mechanistically relevant to BCC yield strength. No citation or prior validation is provided, leaving the construct validity of these predictors unsubstantiated.
